release_title: Sonus v2.6.2 — SQLite Storage Optimization & Miniplayer Persistence
release_notes: 🗄️ Ultra-compact SQLite storage engine with automatic WAL truncation, full vacuuming, and deduplication
🎧 Persistent miniplayer last-played track across app sessions
👆 Left / Right swipe gesture navigation in music player (skip & previous track)
🎨 Dynamic color theme toggle (Off by default for cleaner, consistent visuals)
🗑️ Complete and instant playlist track deletion sync
🔒 Lean MongoDB architecture strictly dedicated to authentication, keys, and pairing
